## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (build, unit, site and browser tests)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, Developer Certificate of Origin)
- [ ] Nothing is sent to another origin: no CDNs, analytics, fonts or APIs; libraries are vendored
- [ ] New tool: every TODO in `tool.json` is filled in, ids are prefixed with the slug, and the page shows a working example on load
- [ ] Keyboard usable, labelled controls, visible focus, readable in light and dark themes
- [ ] New dependency: exact version, AGPL-compatible licence, added to `NOTICE` and the licences page
- [ ] New tool or changed tool code: checked against the security review list in `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] A changelog entry in `changelog.d/` (one file, see its README)
- [ ] If `npm run build` changed `README.md` or `packages/freethetools/README.md`, they are committed
- [ ] Changed `agent.js` or `packages/`: `npm run test:package` passes
